What is Cube House?

Category:Stands Category:Article stubs Category:Articles under construction

Automatic Stands|mangadebut=JORGE JOESTAR Chapter 4: Morioh

Cube House appears as a white [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesseract Tesseract]-like structure because of its four-dimensional interior. Its walls have doors all over them, leading to different rooms. It has no windows or doors from the outside, nor any known entrance.

Its interior is built like a fourth-dimensional Tesseract. With eight rooms joined together on every side. The doors inside of the house leads you to a different room each time. Joji explains that the House defies all logic and the laws of physics because of its bizarre rules. He lists them below in order:
